quote:
And the award for joke of the year goes to GTA 6 

Everyone is saying the graphics are great. I mean, what did you expect from a game that took 13 years to make? The least you could expect is great graphics.Also, the story is actually bad. I’ve completed 50% of the game, and I honestly can’t handle this **** anymore. I’m bored every second I spend playing this game. I just wasted $100 and my time.I don’t even know what direction this game is trying to take. All I can see is nudity, attractive women, and as much focus on sexual content as possible. Is this really what we want from video games?
